LND balance details stay where you scroll while balances and history refresh. Pull down to refresh manually.

On the XBT or SHA-256 Send screen, tap the amount unit to switch between coins, sats, and USDC. USDC entry uses the current NeoxEX quote for that chain. The preview shows the rounded-down coin amount with the fee shown separately.

SHA-256 wallet details show the approximate USDC balance below the coin balance.
